answer: The nectar report exposes the merge explicitly at each jade. Each collapsed cluster gets one ledge weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an farming party who spins up 272 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 74 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1223 identities would post 736 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
